name: JE_NET_AGREEMENTS_INT
description: JE_NET_AGREEMENTS_INT contains general information about netting agreements in the interface table.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_ID
columns.description: Interface record unique identifier.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Record type identifier. Possible values are AGREEMENT, PAY_GROUP, PAYABLES_INV_TYPE, RECEIVABLES_TRX_TYPE, SUPPLIER, CUSTOMER.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the customer and supplier balance netting agreement.

columns.name: LEGAL_ENTITY_NAME
columns.description: Name of the legal entity listed in the Manage Legal Entities task.

columns.name: LOAD_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: Indicates the request id of the interface load job that created the row.

columns.name: IMPORT_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request id of the import process that processed the row.

columns.name: INCLUDED_PAY_GROUPS_CODE
columns.description: Pay groups that must either be included or excluded for the netting agreement. Possible values are A (All), I (Include) and E (Exclude).

columns.name: INCLUDED_TRX_TYPES_CODE
columns.description: Transaction types that must be either included or excluded for the netting agreement. Possible values are A (All), I (Include) and E (Exclude).

columns.name: TRADING_PARTNER_REFERENCE
columns.description: Trading partner reference for the netting agreement.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_START_DATE
columns.description: Start date of the netting agreement.

columns.name: AGREEMENT_END_DATE
columns.description: End date of the netting agreement.

columns.name: CURRENCY_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Rule to group netting currency. Values are sourced from the ORA_JE_NET_CURRENCY_RULE lookup type. Possible values include JE_SINGLE_CURRENCY and JE_WITHIN_CURRENCY.

columns.name: ORDER_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Netting rule that determines the order to sort invoices and transactions. Values are sourced from the ORDER_JE_NET_ORDER_RULE lookup type. Possible values include JE_AMOUNT_ASCENDING,  JE_AMOUNT_DESCENDING, JE_DUEDATE_OLD and JE_TRX_DATE.

columns.name: BALANCE_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Netting rule based on Oracle Payables and Receivable balances. Values are sourced from the ORA_JE_NET_BALANCE_RULE lookup type. Possible values include JE_NET_ALWAYS and JE_NET_PAYABLES.

columns.name: BANK_NAME
columns.description: Name of the bank that is used for netting settlements.

columns.name: BRANCH_NAME
columns.description: Name of the bank branch that is used for netting settlements.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME
columns.description: Netting bank account name to be used during the settlement process.

columns.name: BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM
columns.description: Netting bank account number to be used during the settlement process.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Three character ISO currency code used for netting. Values are sourced from fnd_currencies.

columns.name: ALLOW_DISCOUNT_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates whether the netting process includes discounts on transactions.

columns.name: NETTING_GROUP_CODE
columns.description: Group to define netting agreements. Values are from the ORA_JE_NET_GROUP lookup type.

columns.name: GENERATE_NETTING_LETTER_FLAG
columns.description: This indicates whether netting letters should be generated.

columns.name: LETTER_SUPPLIER_SITE_CODE
columns.description: Site code of the supplier where the netting letter is sent.

columns.name: LETTER_CUSTOMER_SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Site number of the customer where the netting letter is sent.

columns.name: LETTER_LANGUAGE_CODE
columns.description: Language of the netting letter specified by the trading partner. Values are sourced from fnd_languages.

columns.name: SEND_LETTERS_BY_EMAIL_FLAG
columns.description: This indicates whether bursting should be used to automatically deliver netting letters by email.

columns.name: LETTER_TO_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Email address of the recipient when sending netting letters.

columns.name: LETTER_FROM_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Email address of the sender when sending netting letters.

columns.name: LETTER_FROM_NAME
columns.description: Display name of the sender that is to be used when delivering netting letters through bursting.

columns.name: LETTER_REPLY_TO_EMAIL_ADDRESS
columns.description: Reply to email address that is to be used when sending netting letters.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority based on which the customer should be included in the netting settlement.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
columns.description: Account number of the customer assigned to the netting agreement.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_SITE_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique identification number of the customer site assigned to the netting agreement.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_PRIORITY
columns.description: Priority based on which suppliers should be included in the netting agreement.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique number to identify a supplier.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the supplier listed in the Manage Suppliers task.

columns.name: SUPPLIER_SITE
columns.description: Site code to identify the physical location of the supplier.

columns.name: INVOICE_TYPE
columns.description: Payables invoice type assigned to the netting agreement.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_SET_NAME
columns.description: Set name of the transaction type.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CLASS
columns.description: Customer transaction type class code assigned to the netting agreement.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Customer transaction type assigned to the netting agreement.

columns.name: PAY_GROUP
columns.description: Payables invoice pay group. Is used to restrict invoices included in a netting settlement.

columns.name: IMPORT_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: This displays the status of the import. IMPORT_FAILED indicates import failed due to validation errors.

columns.name: IMPORT_ERROR_MSG
columns.description: Message associated with the import error.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
